meta.name: add-wechat
meta.description: Add WeChat (personal) channel integration via Tencent's official iLink Bot API. Uses long-polling and QR scan — no webhook, no ToS risk, no paid token.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 集成微信个人号消息收发，无需付费Token
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要将微信个人号接入自动化流程
copy.tagline_en: Integrate WeChat personal account messaging without paid tokens
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to connect WeChat personal account to automation workflows

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以通过你的个人微信账号收发消息，并自动回复联系人发来的消息。
howto.when: 当你用手机扫描二维码登录微信，并将收到的消息绑定到某个智能体群组后，有联系人向你的微信账号发消息时触发。

say.text: 帮我绑定刚才发消息给我的微信联系人到默认智能体。
say.note: 运行绑定脚本，将未绑定的微信对话关联到智能体。

say.text: 检查微信登录状态，如果过期了重新生成二维码。
say.note: 查看日志或二维码文件，确认是否需要重新扫码。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can send and receive messages through your personal WeChat account and automatically reply to contacts who message you.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a contact sends a message to your WeChat account, after you have scanned the QR code to log in and wired the incoming message to an agent group.

say_en.text: Bind the WeChat contact who just messaged me to the default agent.
Check WeChat login status and regenerate QR code if expired.
say_en.note: Checks logs or QR file to see if re-login is needed.
